input.command:
gh pr create --title "Add --follow mode for continuous log analysis" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Summary
- Add `analyze --follow` / `-f` for `tail -f`-style live analysis: open files at EOF, print findings as they fire, finalize the usual terminal + HTML report on Ctrl+C or `SIGTERM`.
- Extract a shared `AnalysisSession` so batch (`Engine.analyze`) and follow (`follow_sources`) drive the same detection pipeline and produce identical findings for the same lines.
- Document the operator-facing behavior and known limits in the README, add a sandbox demo (`sandbox/demo/follow-demo.sh`), and cover the new path with CLI/engine/tailing tests.

## Test plan
- [ ] `uv run pytest` (or pre-push hooks) — unit suite green
- [ ] `uv run trace-log-sec analyze --help` shows `--follow` / `-f`
- [ ] Batch mode unchanged: `uv run trace-log-sec analyze samples/auth_incidents.log samples/webserver_incidents.log`
- [ ] Live demo: `./sandbox/demo/follow-demo.sh` — alerts stream, Ctrl+C yields full report
- [ ] Confirm empty/unparseable sources under `--follow` print the format-detection hint and exit non-zero

EOF
)" && git status -sb
input.description: Create GitHub pull request with summary
